message:
ci: release workflow building NSIS installer + portable zip on tags

Hosted windows-latest runners carry the MSVC toolchain, so the release
job uses the standard tauri build (no local GNU shim). Triggered by v*
tag push or manual dispatch on an existing tag; fails fast if the tag
does not match package.json/tauri.conf.json versions, and uploads to an
existing release or creates a prerelease with .github/RELEASE_NOTES.md.

Generated with [Devin](https://devin.ai)

## HornScribe — プレビューリリース

Windows向けデスクトップアプリ（Tauri 2 + React + Verovio）。日本語UIのみ。オフライン動作。

### ファイル

- `*-setup.exe` — NSISインストーラー
- `*-portable.zip` — インストール不要のポータブル版（展開して `hornscribe-desktop.exe` を実行）

### 要件

- Windows 10/11 x64 + WebView2ランタイム（Windows 11は標準搭載）
- PDF書き出しには別途 MuseScore Studio が必要（未検出時はPDFのみ無効化）

### 既知の制限

- 採譜エンジン（Pythonサイドカー / Basic Pitch ONNX）は未同梱 — `採譜` はモック動作
- コード署名なし — SmartScreen警告が表示されます
- Narrator実機・200%スケーリング実機確認は手順のみ文書化（`docs/UI_070_VALIDATION_RESULTS.md`）

name: Release

# Tag push (v*) or manual dispatch builds the desktop app on a hosted
# Windows runner (MSVC toolchain is preinstalled there) and publishes the
# NSIS installer + a portable exe zip to a GitHub Release.

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "Existing tag to release (e.g. v0.1.0)"
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/desktop
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.tag || github.ref }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/desktop/package-lock.json

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: apps/desktop/src-tauri

      - name: Verify tag matches app version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          TAG="${{ inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}"
          TAG="${TAG#v}"
          PKG=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          CONF=$(node -p "require('./src-tauri/tauri.conf.json').version")
          [ "$TAG" = "$PKG" ] && [ "$TAG" = "$CONF" ] || {
            echo "::error::tag v$TAG != package.json $PKG / tauri.conf.json $CONF — bump versions first"
            exit 1
          }

      - name: Install frontend deps
        run: npm ci

      - name: Typecheck + unit tests
        run: npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run

      - name: Build NSIS installer
        run: npm run tauri build

      - name: Package portable zip
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $exe = "src-tauri/target/release/hornscribe-desktop.exe"
          $zip = "src-tauri/target/release/HornScribe_${{ inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}_x64-portable.zip"
          Compress-Archive -Path $exe -DestinationPath $zip -Force
          Get-Item $zip | Select-Object Name, Length

      - name: Publish release assets
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          TAG="${{ inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}"
          INSTALLER=$(ls src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis/*-setup.exe)
          PORTABLE=$(ls src-tauri/target/release/*-portable.zip)
          if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" "$INSTALLER" "$PORTABLE" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" "$INSTALLER" "$PORTABLE" \
              --title "HornScribe $TAG" \
              --notes-file ../../.github/RELEASE_NOTES.md \
              --prerelease
          fi
